policy.displayName: Rate limiter quarantined a user or IP

documentation.content:
The rate limiter put a user or an IP in quarantine: it went over its budget 20 times in a minute and is rejected on everything for 10 minutes. Clients don't notice a working limiter, so this is how we know one is looping. The log entry ("Rate limit quarantine started") has 8 characters of the uid or the IP prefix, and the operation.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Un-cliente-en-bucle-%28desde-el-20-nov-2026%29).

conditions.displayName: A quarantine started in the last 10 min
